stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def try_solve3(g, by_color=False, order='rightmost'):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    comps=components(g,by_color)
    comps=sorted(comps,key=lambda comp:-max(c for r,c in comp[1]))
    out=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
    def free(cells):
        return all(0<=r<R and 0<=c<C and out[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells)
    for col,cs in comps:
        cmin=min(c for r,c in cs); cmax=max(c for r,c in cs)
        mir=[(r, cmin+cmax-c) for r,c in cs]
        cands=[]
        for idx,o in enumerate((cs, mir)):
            if idx==1 and sorted(o)==sorted(cs): continue
            mx=max(c for r,c in o); s=C-1-mx
            while s>=0 and not free([(r,c+s) for r,c in o]): s-=1
            if s>=0:
                top=max(c for r,c in o if r==min(r for r,c in o))+s
                cands.append((-s, -top, idx, [(r,c+s) for r,c in o]))
        if not cands: return None
        best=min(cands)  # max s, then max top col, then original
        for r,c in best[3]: out[r][c]=col
    return out

import itertools

def solve(g, keyfn):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    comps=components(g,False)
    comps=sorted(comps,key=keyfn)
    out=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for col,cs in comps:
        mx=max(c for r,c in cs); s=C-1-mx
        while s>=0:
            cells=[(r,c+s) for r,c in cs]
            if all(out[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells): break
            s-=1
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=col
    return out

def keys():
    def k(name):
        def f(comp):
            col,cs=comp
            rmin=min(r for r,c in cs); rmax=max(r for r,c in cs)
            cmin=min(c for r,c in cs); cmax=max(c for r,c in cs)
            return {
              'rmax_desc': -cmax, 'rmax_asc': cmax,
              'rmin_desc': -cmin, 'rmin_asc': cmin,
              'top_left': (rmin,cmin), 'top_right': (rmin,-cmax),
              'bot_right': (rmax,-cmax), 'bot_left': (rmax,cmin),
              'size_desc': (-len(cs),-cmax), 'size_asc': (len(cs),-cmax),
              'color_asc': (col,-cmax), 'color_desc': (-col,-cmax),
              'area_topmost': (rmin,-cmax), 'topmost_rmax': (rmin,-cmax),
            }[name]
        return f
    return [k(n) for n in ['rmax_desc','rmax_asc','rmin_desc','rmin_asc','top_left','top_right','bot_right','bot_left','size_desc','size_asc','color_asc','color_desc']]

def components(g, by_color):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*C for _ in range(R)]
    comps=[]
    if by_color:
        cells={}
        for r in range(R):

                    col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cs=[]

def solve_slide3(gi, keyf):

            if any(g[tr][tc] != 0 and (tr, tc) not in pos for tr, tc in tgt): break
